mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion which may potentiate sympathomimetic effects of lisdexamfetamine and increase cardiovascular risk; lisdexamfetamine's sympathomimetic activity may counteract diuretic efficacy.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum electrolytes closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretic or dose adjustment if combined use is necessary.
